description: Connected-Vehicle Traffic Signal System Modeling -Covettware Project is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Robert Heckendorn (University of Idaho). The dataset is organized in three folders: The data folder with BSM, SPAT, and other data used in the Covettware modeling platform development and testing; the Doc folder with Covettware modeling platform documentations; and the Src folder which includes the Covettware modeling platform source code. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. Formats: TXT, Image. Size stated: 174. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
